title: Explicit Tradeoffs between Adversarial and Natural Distributional Robustness
findings: This paper does not analyze or mention religion, faith, or religious groups. Its focus is on the technical trade-offs between adversarial robustness and natural distributional robustness in computer vision models, analyzing how they rely on core versus spurious features (like image backgrounds).
